map.默认等权（总分 6-30、百分制=总分/30×100）。餐饮/安全对口碑影响大，: Equal weight by default (total 6-30, percentage = total/30×100). Catering and safety affect word of mouth strongly so subjective weighting is possible, but horizontal comparison in inspections should keep equal weights for comparability.
map.：6 维打分：前台 5、客房清洁 4、设施 4、餐饮 3（出餐慢）、安全 5、客: : 6-dimension scoring: front desk 5, room cleaning 4, facilities 4, catering 3 (slow serving), safety 5, customer satisfaction 4 -> total=25, percentage=25/30×100≈83. The weakest is catering (3), so rectify it first (optimise serving flow or add a breakfast station); raising catering to 4 lifts the total to 26 -> 87.
